axes.concept: A decorator’s padded travel case: named projects live in stitched pockets, the zipper opens the collection and each composition can be picked up again.
axes.layout: Stepped three-pocket wall with a larger first pocket and 0/42/84px vertical offsets; full-width title and zipper line. Editor becomes a broad schematic with a narrow unboxed ownership note. Phone uses one vertical pocket sequence.
axes.navigation: Direct actions on each project pocket, a named Back to projects control and a separate browser-scene retrieval link. Authorized staff expose in-flow Mine/Everyone scope controls, never a sidebar or fixed bottom dock.
axes.typography: Embedded Rounded Mplus 1c ExtraBold display at 44–78px and 25px project titles, paired with installed FreeSans at 14–16px for working copy; inflated rounded letterforms echo the padded case and latex without repeating the sibling serif families.
axes.density: Generous 44px desktop and 20px phone gutters, 27px pocket padding; illustrated compositions and named actions instead of compact account rows. Pockets have 60px top lobes, 27px base corners and inset dashed seams.
axes.components: Real installed shadcn/Base UI Button, Input, Skeleton; Animate UI/Base UI modal and alert dialog primitives. Custom stitched project pockets, SVG schematic previews and a Motion zipper slider with keyboard parity.
axes.colour: Pool-blue #c9e7f3 ground, pale blue-white #f3fbff pockets and ink #103247, with deep cyan #07577a action and bright cyan #36c1eb zipper hardware. Pink latex and silver-blue foil define the material. Dark water-blue #102d40/#183e55 uses #82d9ff actions. This deliberately differs from sibling orange/vermilion accents.
axes.motion: Tactile compression and elastic seating: cubic-bezier(.16,1.3,.38,1), expressive 650ms pocket arrival with 70ms offsets, 190ms presses, 850ms zipper travel, 900ms balloon inflation, 5.8s foil rock; Motion spring drag. Reduced/still removes travel, hover transforms and ambient loops.
